label: EntityDescriptor (Root element)
help: The root element of a SAML metadata document must be EntityDescriptor.

label: SPSSODescriptor
help: SPSSODescriptor is required for Service Provider metadata.

label: AssertionConsumerService
help: AssertionConsumerService is where the IdP sends the SAML Response.

label: UIInfo (Discovery metadata)
help: UIInfo contains information for display in discovery services (e.g., Logo, DisplayName).
